player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id} ({role}) mu mupila wa Matching Pennies wa mipindi {num_rounds}.
- Mupindi uliwonse, sambaza [heads] kapena [tails] (kapena [h], [t]).
- Ukapokwana na mwenzi wako, Player 0 akatwala mupindi; ukapopishana, Player 1 akatwala.
Dokeza uluse lako mu mulinganyo wa '[heads]' kapena '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Linganifu -> Mchezaji 0 anashinda.
message.round_mismatch: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Tafauti -> Mchezaji 1 anashinda.

outcome.draw: Mu nshita yonse iyi, tabalile abalwisha.
